papers.title: FRESCO: Benchmarking and Optimizing Re-rankers for Evolving Semantic Conflict in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.supported_change: Test explicit and implicit recency-seeking queries with outdated evidence and temporally valid but insufficient evidence.
papers.correction: Obsolete Ratio is the proportion of factually outdated passages among negative passages ranked above the positive. It is not the fraction of top-ranked outputs that are outdated. The definition continues onto physical page 5, which the reviewer read and the model did not.
papers.design_clarification: Keep static-query controls and fact-validity checks. A recent timestamp alone does not make a passage sufficient or factually current.

papers.title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
papers.supported_change: Report answer, evidence and joint correctness separately and control evidence location and context length.
papers.correction: The illustrated output schema uses a lines array, not a singular line field. Preserve multiple required evidence references.
papers.design_clarification: Joint correctness is a conjunction, not an additive score. Distinguish retrieving any required evidence from retrieving all required evidence; synthetic context faithfulness does not certify real-world truth.

papers.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
papers.supported_change: Accept verified equivalent supporting passages; distinguish partial coverage from all-required-information retrieval and stratify corpus overlap.
papers.correction: The filtering audit treats Fail as the positive class. High recall means detecting invalid items, not retaining valid items; moderate precision can discard valid material. Audit retained invalid items and excluded valid items separately.
papers.design_clarification: Coverage/PerfRecall are retrieval metrics and should not replace generation correctness, support or cost measures. Similarity-versus-redundancy observations across domains do not establish independent causal effects. The publication is ACL 2026, not EACL.

assessment.improvement_over_previous_run: The model used the refreshed declared search scope, completed all six requested physical pages, attributed pages to the correct works, and proposed three concrete diagnostic extensions.

remaining_work: Read code and full benchmark setup/limitations before claiming reproduction of the complete methods.
Construct and audit local temporal and redundancy-aware labels before running the proposed experiments.
Validate effects with matched budgets and uncertainty estimates; no new laboratory performance or universal ranking is claimed.
